# v2.39 Release Notes

This stable release rolls up dev pre-release **v2.39-dev** since the previous
stable (v2.38). Three improvements: a clearer three-way geography split on
offering dashboards, the ability to see and change a student's company from their
record, and consistent theatre / region / country filters across the report
pages.

## Offerings — Onshore, Nearshore, and a new worldwide Offshore

Offering dashboards used to show two columns per required training: **Onshore**
(the selected country/region) and **Offshore** (the rest of that theatre). That
second column is now renamed to **Nearshore**, and a brand-new **Offshore**
column has been added:

- **Onshore** — distinct people holding the training in the selected country (or
  region's countries). The **Met / Not met** badge still compares this against
  the minimum required.
- **Nearshore** — the rest of that country/region's **theatre**, with the
  onshore countries removed (the same figure the old "Offshore" column showed).
- **Offshore** — everyone **worldwide** who holds the training, with the onshore
  countries removed. Because it spans every theatre, Offshore is always at least
  as large as Nearshore.

Nearshore and Offshore are informational — only Onshore drives the Met status.
Each column has a **View** drill-down that lists the people behind the count, and
the three figures are included in the export. The public API
(`GET /api/public/v1/offerings`) now returns `nearshore` and `offshore` counts
plus the corresponding country lists.

## Student records — company is now visible and editable

- The student detail page now shows the student's **Company** in the sub-line
  under their name, alongside theatre, region and country.
- **Edit** now includes a **Company** dropdown, so an admin can move a student to
  a different company they have access to. As before, changes are previewed in a
  confirmation modal before saving.

## Reports — theatre / region / country filters everywhere they make sense

Every per-student report now has the same cascading **Theatre → Region →
Country** scope filter (the one the Renewal Forecast and Program Compliance Trend
reports already used):

- Newly gained the full set: **By Product Type**, **By Function**, **Expiring
  Soon**, **Currently Expired**, and **Legacy Replacement Gap**.
- **Achievement Over Time** gained a Country filter to go with its existing
  theatre and region filters.

Picking a theatre limits the region list to that theatre, picking a region limits
the country list, and changing a higher level resets the ones below it. Leave them
on "All" to see everything. (The Catalogue Health and Comparison reports are
unchanged — the former has no per-student geography, and the latter already
compares geographies side by side.)

## Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- Offering Met status is unchanged — it still depends on Onshore only.
